desc: Parse stdin and separate foods by vitamin type.
Build one calorie-indexed 0/1 knapsack DP array per vitamin in \(O(NX)\) time.
Implement feasibility by finding each vitamin’s minimum calorie cost to reach a target and checking whether their sum is at most \(X\).
Binary-search the maximum feasible target using the minimum total available intake as an upper bound.
Output the answer with the required stdin/stdout structure.
